def rear_extract(list_of_tuples):
    """
    Returns a list containing the rear element of each tuple in the input list.
    
    :param list_of_tuples: List of tuples from which to extract the last element.
    :return: List of last elements from each tuple.
    """
    return [t[-1] for t in list_of_tuples]

# Test cases
assert rear_extract([(1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20), (3, 'Kil', 19)]) == [21, 20, 19]
assert rear_extract([(1, 'Sai', 36), (2, 'Ayesha', 25), (3, 'Salman', 45)]) == [36, 25, 45]
assert rear_extract([(1, 'Sudeep', 14), (2, 'Vandana', 36), (3, 'Dawood', 56)]) == [14, 36, 56]
